title: Symbol Modulator
text: Modulate data bits to complex data symbols, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Phase offset (rad)} sets Phase offset; {Modulation source} sets the source for modulation, {Modulation}, {Modulation array}, {Constellation ordering type} sets the type of constellation, {Constellation mapping}, {Constellation mapping array}, {Phase offset type} sets the type of phase, {Phase offset array (rad)} sets the phase offset array, {Normalization method} scales signal constellation Minimum distance between, {Minimum distance}, {Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} sets the average power of the symbols, {Enable reset input port} sets the reset input port, {Output data type} and {Word length} sets the output word length. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Modulated complex data symbols complex scalar

params.name: Modulation source
params.values: Source for modulation type Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Modulation array
params.values: Modulation array {"BPSK", "QPSK"} (default) | all the supported modulation types

params.name: Constellation ordering type
params.values: Type of constellation ordering Default (default) | User-defined

params.name: Constellation mapping array
params.values: Constellation mapping array {[0 1],[0 1 3 2]} (default) | row vector in a cell array

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase offset 0 (default) | pi | pi/2 | pi/4 | pi/8 | pi/16 | pi/32 | -pi/32 | -pi/16 | -pi/8 | -pi/4 | -pi/2

params.name: Phase offset type
params.values: Type of phase offset Default (default) | User-defined

params.name: Phase offset array (rad)
params.values: Phase offset array [0 pi/4] (default) | scalar | row vector of supported phase offset values

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: Scale signal constellation Minimum distance between symbols (default) | Average power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: Minimum distance between symbols 0.125 (default) | positive scalar in the range from 1/32 to 1/8

params.name: Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)
params.values: Average power of the symbols in the constellation 1 (default) | positive scalar in the range 1/32 to 10

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type selection Custom (default) | double | single

params.name: Word length
params.values: Output word length 16 (default) | integer in the range from 3 to 32
